title: Replacement plugs for the pilot line
passage:
Document 1 — Parts counter reference
North Shop | Locked plug types
Code | Cable size | Lock | Shelf quantity
P14 | thin | lever | 8
P19 | thick | lever | 3
P22 | thin | sliding | 6
P25 | thick | sliding | 4

A test unit may use either lock style if the cable size matches. If a unit will be sent to a customer, match both its cable size and the lock style stated on its build sheet. The lock styles cannot be mixed within a customer job.

The shelf quantities include two P14 plugs set aside for a training session. Other shelf stock is not set aside. Do not borrow those two plugs unless the training lead releases them. Put all unmatched samples back in their original bags. Mark any damaged plug unusable as soon as you find it, but keep it in the shelf count until the return desk accepts it.

Document 2 — Message from the line lead
I need five thin-cable plugs with lever locks for the Elmar order. Two thin-cable test units on my bench need plugs as well. These test units will stay here even if the customer work goes out today. The Elmar plugs must be ready now; the bench units may use anything allowed by the counter reference, but please keep at least one usable thin-cable plug as a spare after filling both requests.

Kara from training can release the two reserved plugs tomorrow, not this afternoon. When Omar checked the shelf, he picked up a bag marked P25 and called it a thin-cable part. I left it beside the counter so you can check it before he comes back. Separately, one of the P19 plugs on the shelf has a bent pin. The return desk hasn’t accepted it yet.
passageZh:
文件一｜零件櫃台資料
北區工坊｜帶鎖扣的接頭
代號｜電纜粗細｜鎖扣｜貨架數量
P14｜細｜扳桿式｜8
P19｜粗｜扳桿式｜3
P22｜細｜滑扣式｜6
P25｜粗｜滑扣式｜4

只要電纜粗細相符，測試機可用任一種鎖扣。如果機器要出給客戶，電纜粗細和鎖扣樣式都須符合生產單。同一筆客戶工單不得混用不同樣式的鎖扣。

貨架數量已包含為訓練課保留的兩個 P14 接頭。其餘架上庫存未被保留。除非訓練負責人同意釋出，不得借用那兩個。請把不符合需求的樣品放回各自原本的袋子。發現損壞的接頭，請立即標記為不可用；在退貨櫃台受理前，仍將它計入架上數量。

文件二｜產線領班訊息
我需要五個適用細電纜的扳桿式鎖扣接頭，供艾爾瑪訂單使用。我工作台上的兩台細電纜測試機也需要接頭。即使今天把客戶機器出掉，這兩台測試機仍會留在這裡。艾爾瑪的接頭現在就要備妥；工作台上的機器可用櫃台資料允許的任一款，但兩筆需求都備妥後，請至少留一個可用的細電纜接頭備用。

訓練組的卡拉明天才能釋出保留的兩個接頭，今天下午不行。歐瑪查看貨架時拿起標為 P25 的袋子，說它是細電纜零件。我把它留在櫃台旁，讓你在他回來前核對。另外，架上有一個 P19 的端子彎了，退貨櫃台還沒受理。
